|{1:* }{2:bold}{1: one}|
|{3:** }{2:bold}{3: two}|
|{4:*** }{2:bold}{4: three}|
|{5:**** }{6:italic}{5: and }{2:bold}{5: four}|
|{7:***** }{8:under}{7: }{9:verbatim}{7: }{10:code}{7: }{11:strike}{7: five}|
|Body with {2:bold}, {6:italic} and {9:verbatim}.|

{1} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title [bold]
{2} OrgBold [bold]
{3} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant
{4} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier
{5} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement [bold]
{6} OrgItalic [italic]
{7} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc
{8} OrgUnderline [underline]
{9} OrgVerbatim -> String
{10} OrgCode -> String
{11} OrgStrikethrough [strikethrough]
